name: Sabine Winterfeldt
bio: Sabine Winterfeldt is a German stage and screen actress, director, and writer.

credits.title: Monster im Kopf
credits.overview: Sandra, a young mother-to-be, fights to have her child stay with her after birth while she serves a prison sentence for aggravated assault.

credits.title: Die Rüden
credits.overview: Four convicted violent criminals, three highly aggressive dogs and a woman who is ready to fight against the cycle of violence and rigid institutions. But above all against her own doubts about redemption from evil.

credits.title: God
credits.overview: A psych-drama-thriller combo that tackles shady politicians, leaked documents and a lack of enthusiasm for religion.

credits.title: Umbilical Cord
credits.overview: Todor is in his early thirties and lives with his mother, reliant on her cooking, ironing, washing, and company. The comfort of this co-dependent lifestyle is suddenly altered one night when Todor arrives home late after an office party.
